summary.text: Front-of-house worker with restaurant experience greeting guests, taking orders, and handling the register and cash drawer. During a career break, volunteered in a school front office, checking in visitors and answering parents' questions.

breakBullets.text: Checked in visitors in an elementary school front office.
Helped run the checkout table at the school book fair.

bullets.text: Ran the register and counted the cash drawer at closing.
